tools.name: get_web_capabilities
tools.description: Describe Evercraft Web capabilities for AI agents, including URL fetch/extraction, future web search, browser automation, cloud/headless browser execution, web-agent navigation, Playwright/CDP-style control, and user-authorized authenticated browsing. This tool is read-only and reports live versus h

tools.name: route_web_request
tools.description: Use this before selecting a web-search, URL-fetch, browser-automation, cloud-browser, headless-browser, Playwright/CDP, or authenticated-browser provider. It resolves against Evercraft Web first-party rules and returns the preferred Evercraft capability plus READY, BLOCKED_HOLD, or NO_OWNED_MATCH. F

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch one public HTTP(S) URL without cookies or credentials and return bounded clean text, title, meta description, canonical URL, headings, outbound links, final URL, redirect hops, status, byte count, truncation flags, SHA-256 content hash, evidence-receipt hash, retrieval time, and safety metadat

tools.name: fetch_urls
tools.description: Fetch up to five public HTTP(S) URLs in one bounded request. Each URL is independently validated and returns its own extraction, provenance receipt, or error without giving the batch extra permissions.

tools.name: inspect_site
tools.description: Read a public seed page plus up to four same-origin linked pages and return compact readable text, headings, links, source hashes and evidence receipts. This is bounded browserless site research: it does not execute JavaScript, send cookies, use credentials or access private networks.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "fetch_url" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "evercraftWebMcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_web_capabilities, route_web_request, fetch_url, fetch_urls · Private data: fetch_url, inspect_site · Public sink: inspect_site · Destructive: inspect_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_web_capabilities, route_web_request, fetch_url, fetch_urls · Private data: fetch_url, inspect_site · Public sink: inspect_site · Destructive: inspect_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
